text:
Amy Chen: Heads-up — need two exception asks for the upcoming QBR slate: IntegrateX (SI) and CloudRange (cloud marketplace). IntegrateX needs extra MDF for dev integration (~$40k). CloudRange asking to extend announcement runway to 6 weeks and add co-marketing credits. :eyes:
Ben Park: Can you drop the exact budget line items? dev hours vs ad spend etc.
Amy Chen: IntegrateX: $28k eng hours, $7k testing/qa, $5k deployment credits = $40k total. CloudRange: no extra spend, just 6-week runway + $10k marketplace tile credit if we approve.
Charlie Nguyen: Finance note: >$50k needs exec sign-off. $40k is okay with standard approvals, but we need scorecard gating for tier exceptions. Who owns the scorecard waiver?
Devon Patel: IntegrateX is borderline Tier 2->3 based on ARR. They cleared performance score but short on joint pipeline. This would be a one-off to keep SI roadmap aligned.
Priya Rao: I can own the waiver request. I'll attach the partner scorecard snapshot and a short justification. Also drafting the announcement runbook checklist — will include embargo window, co-branded assets, marketplace listing draft, and partner comms timeline.
ops-bot: Policy snippet: "MDF exceptions <= $50k may be approved by Head of Partnerships + Finance; exceptions to announcement runway require Marketing ok and product readiness confirmation." (link: https://redwood.company/policies/mdf-exceptions)
Charlie Nguyen: OK — Priya + Amy put together a 1-pager with: ask, measurable goals (pipeline uplift, SI deliverables), timeline, rollback criteria. Finance will review within 48h once submitted.
Ben Park: For CloudRange runway — marketing needs at least 3 weeks to prep assets. 6 weeks is fine but call out a hard freeze for product changes at week 4.
Priya Rao: Noted. Draft checklist snippet (quick):
```
- Week -6: NDA + joint announcement outline
- Week -4: Finalize assets + marketplace tile draft
- Week -2: Internal QA + embargo memo
- Day 0: Publish blog + marketplace tile + partner webinar
- +2w: Lead handoff to bizdev
```
Priya Rao: I'll post the 1-pager by EOD and tag Finance + Marketing. Can Amy confirm IntegrateX signed SOW covers the eng hours rate?
Amy Chen: Confirmed — SOW signed at standard SI rate. I've asked IntegrateX for an exact dev schedule; will add to the doc. :thumbsup:
Devon Patel: If we approve, let's add a canary rollback plan: marketplace tile can be toggled and co-marketing paused. Keeps risk low.
Priya Rao: Will include canary toggles and success metrics (MQLs, demo requests). Planning to submit for review in the morning.
Charlie Nguyen: Sounds good. Finance will review when posted. If any numbers creep above $50k ping me immediately.
Amy Chen: Thanks everyone — will wait for Priya's doc then move to formal approval flow.
Ben Park: Thanks — standing by for the 1-pager. :handshake:
